purpose: PLAN_M5 M5.3 rt_water_compose at S8 Water Queens House (geometry and reflections on throughout; compose=1 at launch so the patched water FS variants exist, toggled live). S8's planes are 7b44a567 huge_PixelLighting and c4e92ccd NoCaustics_Waves, both mapped; the water pass holds other forward draws, so the pass is found by its water draw. Rerun after the m5w3 fixes (compose on every rendered frame: the pass binds the GPU-current lighting copy; tier words; ratio line). A 15 s precheck with the key on (its [water] compose lines need records, owned pixels and composed pixels > 0: a view without water is INVALID), then OFF / ON / OFF with diag-off cost windows and one PNG each, and the delta view (rt_debug 25) over the water. Gates: shot-off-a vs shot-off-b within the OFF repeat noise (the variant is not bound with the key off); shot-on differs from OFF only on water pixels; owned share, unresolved share, mean delta and the energy line reported; [water] compose GPU median and p90, cost-on minus cost-off against the OFF spread.
